title: The Great White Way show with a six-piece band, then Young sends tickets
summary: Phillips's six-piece band joins Jim Thomas's Great White Way show, makes no money, quits in Memphis in 1926 and Willis Young sends tickets for them to return.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: White Way Shows. We went over with that show. And they didn't make no money.
So you three joined that show, is that what you're saying?
Yeah, we joined that show. The guy that had the show was named Jim Thomas.
You and Jones and Clark joined...
And my brother.
Oh, and your brother joined.
Right.
Did Clarence play in your band when you had your band?
Yeah.
He was playing bass, right?
Saxophone.
What saxophone did he play at that time?
Alto. See, he was alto saxophone... Mr. Young was teaching him saxophone all the time he was on the show.
But usually he played bass horn
Yeah, bass horn. But he quit playing. He didn't play the bass with us. He was playing the saxophone well enough to play with us. He wasn't great, but, I mean, he was playing it well enough.
So all four of you joined that Great White Way show.
Yeah. It was all six of us, the whole band.
Phillips - 45
The whole six-piece band. Who were the other two members?
Frenchy... What was Frenchy's name? Frenchy Bedour(?).
What was he playing?
Drums.
Who else was in there?
Theodore Herbert. He was playing piano. That was it -- that was six.
Then you all went into that other show.
We went into the other show. And didn't make no money. So...
That was in the beginning of '26, right?

Yeah. That's the first time I saw Ethel Waters, was in 1926, in Memphis. That's where we quit this show, in Memphis. Old Man Young sent for us again -- ha! He sent for all of us to come back on the show. He had a little show up there in Illinois somewhere, and he sent us tickets.
All six of you.
Yeah.
So two of them hadn't been in the band before, I guess.
Who is that?
Frenchy and Theodore Herbert. Had they ever been in the Young band before?
No. French didn't go; Frenchy back home.
Phillips - 46
Everybody went over there but Frenchy.
And it was the first time Herbert had been in the band.
Yeah, that's the first time.
All the other four had been in it.

Yeah, we went over there. So Herbert, he and Mr. Young got into some kind of disagreement about something, and he quit, he left, and he went somewhere... I don't know where, but I think he went back to Old Man DeParis, Sidney's dad -- I think he went on that show.
